title: 15.54. Bhāvanāyapahātabbaduka, Kusalattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṁ kusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nabhāvanāya pahātabbo nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṁ …pe… avigate ekaṁ.
Bhāvanāya pahātabbaṁ akusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nabhāvanāya pahātabbo naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. Hetuyā dve …pe… avigate dve.
Nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṁ abyākataṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nanabhāvanāya pahātabbo naabyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. Hetuyā dve …pe… avigate dve.
